prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Caesium (Cs) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a maintenance shed with a long workbench, tool racks overhead and its door open onto the yard
Weather / season: a snowy day — snow falls or lies outside, with frost on any window.
Light direction: two-colour light — warm indoor light on one side, cool daylight or dusk on the other.
Outfit: a Greek chiton — a long draped dress pinned at both shoulders with gold brooches, a high side slit, a gold cord crossed under the bust and gold arm cuffs — in a monochrome palette of black and charcoal with at most one white or grey accent; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing at a work surface, upper body leaning slightly forward over it, hips back and weight on both feet.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera slightly below, looking up at her; she is placed in the left third of the frame, open space of the place to her right; a second space shows beyond her through an opening — a door, an arch or a window.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with both hands she writes in a notebook with a pen on the table — her own right hand holds the pen, her own left hand keeps the page flat.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: soft distant eyes, faint wistful half-smile, brows gently raised at the inner ends.

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — caesium: a soft, pale-gold alkali metal that melts in a warm hand at about 28 degrees and explodes on touching water, the most violently reactive of the stable alkali metals, so it is kept sealed in glass ampoules under inert gas; found in 1860 in boiled-down spring water, the first element ever discovered with the spectroscope, and named from Latin caesius, sky blue, for the two bright blue lines in its flame; since 1967 the second is defined as 9,192,631,770 vibrations of the caesium atom, counted by atomic clocks — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
acceptance: user chose 1,1,1 and authorized main publication

observations: Original verified 1024x1536; one adult woman in focus; reference face/hair colour and painterly rendering followed.
Both hands and arms attach naturally while writing; lower body outside waist-up crop.
Notebook and pen, chiton and industrial interior visible; decorative elemental motifs retained.
